image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison's head and forequarters against a snowy background. The bison has thick, dark brown shaggy fur, a prominent shoulder hump, and a visible horn curving upward. The eye is dark and alert. The lower jaw features a beard of long hair. One front leg is partially visible, appearing sturdy and covered in fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the frame. A short, curved horn is clearly visible on the side facing the camera.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the description of a bison beard.
The visible eye is dark and clearly defined.
No large, protruding ears are visible; the ear region is covered by the thick fur of the head, consistent with 'hidden in fur'.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight crop focusing on the head and neck. The full body proportions and withers height cannot be fully assessed due to framing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur is visibly shaggy and dark brown. The curvature of the neck into the shoulder suggests the presence of the characteristic hump, though the full extent is cropped.
The hindquarters are completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is relatively short and stout, consistent with bison morphology.
Only the upper part of one front leg is visible. The feet and hooves are not in the frame.
The tail is not visible in this head-and-shoulders crop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and minor blending/bleeding where the dark fur meets the bright white snow, particularly around the chin beard. This is common in AI generation but could also be depth-of-field blur. It lacks the sharp crispness of a high-end wildlife photograph.

The definition of the mouth line and the transition from the nose to the beard is slightly indistinct and 'mushy'. The anatomical structure of the jawline feels somewhat softened rather than structurally rigid.
